def find_possible_friends(n, friends):
    total_friends = sum(friends)
    possible_friends = []

    for i in range(n + 1):
        if (total_friends + i) % 2 == 0 and (total_friends + i) // 2 in set(friends):
            possible_friends.append(i)

    return possible_friends if possible_friends else [-1]
